6. Use titles and last names: Use titles and last names when addressing Japanese business partners, and use their titles when referring to them.
7. Avoid pointing: Pointing is considered rude in Japanese culture. Use your hands to gesture instead.
8. Respect hierarchy: Japanese culture values hierarchy and respect for authority. Show respect for your Japanese business partners' position and rank.
9. Be patient: Japanese culture values patience and politeness. Be patient and polite when communicating with your Japanese business partners, even if you disagree with them.
10. Learn some Japanese: Learning some basic Japanese phrases and customs can show respect and appreciation for Japanese culture and help build trust with your Japanese business partners.
